zones.name: Harding, Butte, Northern Meade Co Plains, Pennington Co Plains, Sturgis/Piedmont Foothills, Southern Meade Co Plains
zones.description: The grassland fire danger index will reach the high category this afternoon. Unfavorable weather conditions and low moisture content of grasses, and other dry organic material on the ground, indicate that there is high potential for a fire to spread. Outdoor burning should be restricted to early morning or evening hours when wind speeds are usually lower and the relative humidity is higher.

zones.name: Northern Perkins, Ziebach, Northern Foothills, Rapid City, Southern Foothills, Custer Co Plains, Haakon, Western Fall River, Northern Oglala Lakota, Northern Jackson, Bennett, Mellette, Todd, Tripp, Hermosa Foothills, Eastern Fall River, Southern Oglala Lakota, Southern Jackson, Southern Perkins
zones.description: The grassland fire danger index will reach the moderate category this afternoon. Marginal weather conditions or a lowering moisture content of grasses, and other dry organic material on the ground, indicate that there is some potential for a fire to spread. Any outdoor burning should be closely monitored.
